name: Thug
summary: A brutal intimidator who prolongs fear and turns sneak attacks into sickening beatings.

features.name: Frightening
features.summary: Extend demoralize by 1 round and optionally turn 4 or more shaken rounds into 1 frightened round.

features.name: Brutal Beating
features.summary: Forgo 1d6 sneak attack damage to sicken the target.
